summary: Provision instant temporary Postgres databases via Claimable Postgres by Neon (neon.new) with no login, signup, or credit card. Supports REST API, CLI, and SDK. Use when users ask for a quick Postgres environment, a throwaway DATABASE_URL for prototyping/tests, or "just give me a DB now". Triggers include: "quick postgres", "temporary postgres", "no signup database", "no credit card database", "instant DATABASE_URL", "npx neon-new", "neon.new", "neon.new API", "claimable postgres API".
